name: abdallah-hatem

plugins.name: abdallah-skills
plugins.description: Frontend and backend conventions for Next.js + NestJS + Prisma, plus a correction-capture loop.

plugins.name: dev-watch
plugins.description: Band above the prompt when a turn ends with Docker, simulators or dev servers still running, with Stop all / Keep running; /stopdev for a full teardown.

plugins.name: safe-guard
plugins.description: Blocks dangerous shell commands before they run: pkill node, git push without a go-ahead, commits as a blocked identity or with conflict markers, Docker volume wipes, rm -rf outside a project. Configure in ~/.claude/safe-guard.json.

plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Band with your 5-hour usage burn and pace, coloured easy/normal/heavy, refreshed every minute.

plugins.name: learnings
plugins.description: Puts ~/.claude/LEARNINGS.md and the project's .claude/LEARNINGS.md in full into the main session's system prompt.

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: Band listing running subagents with elapsed time, red when one goes quiet or sits on a background run.

plugins.name: control-watch
plugins.description: Band showing what Claude is controlling (your Chrome, desktop apps, Docker, simulators, terminals), with a macOS notification when it takes over your browser or an app.

description: Abdallah's Claude Code skills and mods: opinionated Next.js and NestJS + Prisma conventions, a hook-backed loop that records corrections, and function-hook mods for dev-tool hygiene, safety and visibility.
